summary: Field action for an NPC disguised as a prop: measures the player distance against a squared radius, latches a mimic trigger id, and tracks a target position.
evidence: Ctor 0x00332B38 calls the Ui_Object base ctor and installs PTR_DAT_00332d70 / PTR_DAT_00332d74, then clears trigger id +0xC4 to 0xFF; Start 0x0033242C and Update 0x00332648 read the actor at +0x28 (fields +0x26A, +0x26C, +0x2B4) and drive the embedded object at +0x2C through vtable +0x10 / +0x14.

fields.name: vtable
fields.evidence: The ctor writes PTR_DAT_00332d70 and PTR_DAT_00332d74 to the first two words (vtable and secondary interface) inherited from Ui_Object.

fields.name: maybe_ownerKind
fields.evidence: Ctor stores puVar2 into puVar3[8] (self + 0x20); Gfx_ObjectDesc_Init treats +0x20 as a kind/owner argument, but the actual use here is unconfirmed.

fields.name: actor
fields.evidence: Read 14 times: *(char*)(actor+0x26A), *(byte*)(actor+0x2B4), *(int*)(actor+0x26C); these are Field actor fields also used by other Field actions.

fields.name: maybe_stateSequencer
fields.evidence: Embedded object at self + 0x2C is constructed by FUN_0021C2DC(puVar2 + 0xB) and driven through vtable entries +0x10 (reset) and +0x14 (set state 1/2).

fields.name: squaredRadius
fields.evidence: Update stores fVar9 * fVar9 here and compares the squared player distance against it, so this is a squared radius, not a length.

fields.name: maybe_radius
fields.evidence: Start stores the incoming argument (in_s0) here; likely the unsquared radius or a height, but no read appears in the analysed bodies.

fields.name: triggerId
fields.evidence: Initialised to 0xFF and replaced with 0x16 while it is still the signed -1 sentinel; compared as an animation/event trigger id.

fields.name: maybe_flagC5
fields.evidence: Cleared to 0 in the ctor; no other access was found, so the purpose is unknown.

fields.name: maybe_flagC6
fields.evidence: Cleared to 0 in the ctor; no other access was found, so the purpose is unknown.

fields.name: targetX
fields.evidence: Written from uVar6 / uStack_20; together with +0xD0 and +0xD4 this forms a 3-float target position.

fields.name: targetY
fields.evidence: Written from uVar7 / uStack_1C; middle component of the target position triple.

fields.name: targetZ
fields.evidence: Written from uVar8 / uStack_18; last component of the target position triple.

summary: Walk action moving an actor toward a cached target position, with arrival/facing checks, turn timing, and movement event handling.
evidence: WalkAction_Init 0x003A48AC resets the flags and copies actor +0x370 / +0x374 / +0x378 into +0x38 / +0x3C / +0x40, storing a 0.1 speed at +0x48; Update 0x003A4C78 and UpdateFacing 0x003A4A68 drive arrival and turn flags; vtable 0x007681A0.

fields.name: actor
fields.evidence: Read 20 times and dereferenced through vtable +0x6C / +0x84; actor fields +0x164 and +0x370 are used, so this is the owning Field actor.

fields.name: isFinished
fields.evidence: Set to 0 in Init and to 1 when the walk completes; only a byte is written and read.

fields.name: maybe_turnTimer
fields.evidence: Written once from uVar3 while the actor turns; grouped with +0x34, which accumulates time, so it is likely a turn start timestamp.

fields.name: maybe_turnTimerElapsed
fields.evidence: Accumulated by in_s0 each update and compared with 0x3FFFFFFF as an int; a turn/timer deadline, but the unit is not confirmed.

fields.name: targetX
fields.evidence: Copied from actor +0x370 and later subtracted from the current position; X component of the walk target.

fields.name: targetY
fields.evidence: Copied from actor +0x374; Y component of the walk target.

fields.name: targetZ
fields.evidence: Copied from actor +0x378; Z component of the walk target.

fields.name: isArrived
fields.evidence: Cleared and raised around the arrival test and then tested as a boolean.

fields.name: moveSpeed
fields.evidence: Init stores a small float here (0.1) and Update multiplies the step by it.

fields.name: isGrounded
fields.evidence: Cached ground-hit flag: cleared at start and then set from a collision query result (uVar2).

fields.name: isPlayerMoving
fields.evidence: Set from *(char*)(*(int*)(*piVar1 + 8) + 0x44) != 0; it is a byte despite the batch reporting 4 bytes.

fields.name: isTurning
fields.evidence: Toggled around the facing update: set to 1 while the actor turns toward the target and cleared afterwards.

summary: Ascent action that moves the owning actor along a constant velocity and marks itself finished when the ascent condition clears.
evidence: Ctor 0x003E4530 calls the Actor_Action base ctor (0x00294BD4), installs DAT_003e45A4, sets state byte +0x2C to 2, and copies the global 2-float pair DAT_003e45A8 into +0x30/+0x34 and +0x38/+0x3C; Update 0x003E461C integrates actor +0x100 / +0x104 / +0x108 and sets +0x38 to 1 when the movement flag clears.

fields.name: vtable
fields.evidence: Installed from DAT_003e45A4 immediately after the Actor_Action base constructor.

fields.name: actor
fields.evidence: Dereferenced in Update (vtable +0x68 and actor +0x40..+0x42 words) and passed to FUN_005E7848(actor,1) on completion.

fields.name: maybe_state
fields.evidence: Ctor writes byte 2 at +0x2C (puVar2 + 0xB); a state/type byte, but no state-machine read was found.

fields.name: maybe_anchorX
fields.evidence: First float of the global pair DAT_003e45A8 copied by the ctor; no later read appears in the available body, so its role is unconfirmed.

fields.name: maybe_anchorY
fields.evidence: Second float of the global pair DAT_003e45A8 copied by the ctor; no later read appears in the available body.

fields.name: isFinished
fields.evidence: Update writes byte 1 here when the movement-state test fails, then releases the actor; the ctor also word-copies the global pair over this offset, so its float interpretation in the ctor is stale/overlapping.

fields.name: unknown_0x3C
fields.evidence: Ctor copies puVar1[1] here, but no read or documented meaning was found; kept unknown.

fields.name: unknown_0x40
fields.evidence: Ctor zero-initialises this word; no read was found in the available Update, so the purpose is unknown.

fields.name: unknown_0x44
fields.evidence: Ctor zero-initialises this word; no read was found in the available Update, so the purpose is unknown.

fields.name: unknown_0x48
fields.evidence: Ctor clears this byte only; no read was found, so the purpose is unknown.

fields.name: maybe_embeddedMover
fields.evidence: FUN_0017C4CC(puVar2 + 0x13) initialises an object starting at +0x4C; its vtable and meaning are not documented.

summary: Spin action rotating an actor around a world-space pivot: computes an angular phase, applies a scaled direction vector, and drives actor position and orientation.
evidence: Update 0x00592D14 derives an angle from *(*(int*)(self+0x24)+0x44), scales the vector at +0x44/+0x48/+0x4C by sqrt(1-sin^2), then adds offsets +0x2C/+0x30/+0x34 to actor +0x9C/+0xA0/+0xA4; vtable 0x0077DA44.

fields.name: maybe_actionContainer
fields.evidence: Dereferenced as *(int*)(self+0x24)+0x44 to obtain the phase/counter; the same pattern appears in ClimbAction +0x24, so it is likely an action-state container, but the type is unconfirmed.

fields.name: actor
fields.evidence: Passed to FUN_005AFF48 / FUN_00669D88 and FUN_002340B0; actor +0x9C / +0xA0 / +0xA4 / +0x100 are written.

fields.name: offsetX
fields.evidence: Added to actor +0x9C (X) after the local rotation offset.

fields.name: offsetY
fields.evidence: Added to actor +0xA0 (Y) after the local rotation offset.

fields.name: offsetZ
fields.evidence: Added to actor +0xA4 (Z) after the local rotation offset.

fields.name: maybe_rotationAxisX
fields.evidence: Start of a 3-float tuple passed by address to FUN_00574548 together with the pivot at +0x50; likely a rotation/axis vector, but components +0x3C/+0x40 are not listed by the batch.

fields.name: directionX
fields.evidence: Multiplied by local_50 (sqrt(1-sin^2)) to form the X component of the displacement vector.

fields.name: directionY
fields.evidence: Multiplied by local_50 to form the Y component of the displacement vector.

fields.name: directionZ
fields.evidence: Multiplied by local_50 to form the Z component of the displacement vector.

fields.name: maybe_pivotX
fields.evidence: Start of a 3-float tuple passed to FUN_00574548 as the pivot/rotation reference; components +0x54/+0x58 are not listed by the batch.

fields.name: maybe_spinRate
fields.evidence: Scales the angular expression (fVar3 - fVar2*fVar4)*DAT_00592F40; a spin-rate/turn weight whose exact use is not confirmed.

summary: Dragon jump action: computes a launch direction and speed toward a target, tracks airborne movement, and latches launch-request flags.
evidence: Update 0x003E4C14 compares the squared vector at +0x40/+0x44/+0x48 against a distance, scales speed +0x4C, and propagates +0x52 into +0x50; actor at +0x28 is read through vtable +0x9C and effect helpers.

fields.name: actor
fields.evidence: Dereferenced 9 times and passed to FUN_00669D88 / FUN_005F5F54; matches the owner pointer used by the other Field action classes.

fields.name: directionX
fields.evidence: First component of the target/direction vector whose squared length is compared in Update.

fields.name: directionY
fields.evidence: Second component of the target/direction vector.

fields.name: directionZ
fields.evidence: Third component of the target/direction vector.

fields.name: speed
fields.evidence: Multiplied by fVar7 and the frame delta to produce the movement step.

fields.name: maybe_launchFlag
fields.evidence: If zero, Update copies +0x52 into this byte; a latched launch/pending state.

fields.name: maybe_canLaunch
fields.evidence: Tested as a boolean in Update; no write appears in the analysed bodies, so it is an input/state flag.

fields.name: maybe_pendingLaunchFlag
fields.evidence: Source byte copied into +0x50 when +0x50 is zero; not written in the analysed bodies.

summary: NPC fall action: integrates vertical fall speed and acceleration for an NPC actor, handles landing, and keeps a 3-float reference vector.
evidence: Update 0x00332270 integrates +0xBC with acceleration +0xC0 scaled by +0x3C; LandedUpdate 0x0033291C handles ground contact; Start 0x0033205C calls actor APIs through +0x28 and initialises the state object at +0x2C.

fields.name: actor
fields.evidence: Read 37 times and used with actor vtable +0x3C, FUN_00627F20 and FUN_001798D0; the owning Field actor.

fields.name: maybe_stateSequencer
fields.evidence: Address self + 0x2C is passed to helper(s) as an object; the same embedded-state pattern as NpcMimicAction, with the exact type unconfirmed.

fields.name: speedScale
fields.evidence: Scales the integrated fall value: +0xBC += +0xC0 * +0x3C, and the result is multiplied by +0x3C.

fields.name: fallSpeed
fields.evidence: Current fall velocity/value; integrated by the acceleration term and used for the fall distance.

fields.name: fallAcceleration
fields.evidence: Acceleration term added to +0xBC each update, scaled by +0x3C and the frame delta.

fields.name: maybe_flagC5
fields.evidence: Tested as a boolean in Update; no write was found, so the source of the condition is unknown.

fields.name: maybe_flagC6
fields.evidence: Tested as a boolean in Update; no write was found, so the source of the condition is unknown.

fields.name: maybe_referenceX
fields.evidence: First float of a 3-float reference vector starting at +0xCC (followed by +0xD0/+0xD4) and filled by FUN_005E8BEC.

summary: Climb action: evaluates a dot-product distance gate, starts and stops climbing state, and advances a per-frame climb rate while keeping the actor attached.
evidence: Start 0x003E539C and Update 0x003E54E4 set and clear byte flags at +0x2C/+0x2D/+0x2E and advance the float at +0x30 using constants; Update reads actor +0x314 and calls actor vtable +0x84; vtable 0x0076B0D8.

fields.name: vtable
fields.evidence: Installed from DAT_003e5724 by the constructor.

fields.name: maybe_actionContainer
fields.evidence: Dereferenced as *(int*)(self+0x24)+0x44 and compared with DAT_003e5660; likely the actor's action/state container, but the type is unconfirmed.

fields.name: actor
fields.evidence: Read 17 times (actor +0x314, vtable +0x84) and passed to FUN_00669E6C; the owning Field actor.

fields.name: maybe_isNear
fields.evidence: Set from a dot-product test (dot < fVar10); it is a byte despite the batch reporting 4 bytes.

fields.name: maybe_isClimbing
fields.evidence: Set to 1/0 around the climb state transitions and tested as a boolean.

fields.name: maybe_isFinished
fields.evidence: Set to 1 at start and cleared on completion; tested as a boolean.

fields.name: maybe_climbRate
fields.evidence: Initialised to DAT_003e54A8 and recomputed from constants divided by a distance/timer (DAT_003e54C0, DAT_003e567C); a per-frame climb rate.

summary: Hell tackle action: three-phase dash that stores a launch direction and speed, plays the Hell_TackleLoop animation, and moves the actor.
evidence: Start 0x003E58C4 stores the direction locals at +0x30/+0x34/+0x38 and speed at +0x3C, then plays 'Hell_TackleLoop'; Update 0x003E5984 advances phase byte +0x2C through 0/1/2; vtable 0x0076B174.

fields.name: actor
fields.evidence: Passed to FUN_00669D88 and used with actor vtable +0x84 to play 'Hell_TackleLoop'.

fields.name: phase
fields.evidence: State-machine byte with 0 -> 1 -> 2 transitions in Start/Update.

fields.name: directionX
fields.evidence: Launch direction X stored from local_24 at start.

fields.name: directionY
fields.evidence: Launch direction Y stored from local_20 at start.

fields.name: directionZ
fields.evidence: Launch direction Z stored from local_1C at start.

fields.name: speed
fields.evidence: Scaled by DAT_003e5968 at start and by DAT_003e5B78 in Update; the dash speed.

evidence: Start 0x005926BC plays 'Bee_Rise' and resets actor flag +0x119; Update 0x0059276C advances phase byte +0x2C through 0/1/2 and scales +0x30 by DAT_0059298C; vtable 0x0077DA10.

fields.name: vtable
fields.evidence: Installed from DAT_005929d4 by the constructor.

fields.name: actor
fields.evidence: Read 12 times (actor +0x119/+0x3A0, vtable +0x84/+0x9C) and passed to the Bee_Rise animation helper.

fields.name: phase
fields.evidence: Phase/state byte advanced 0 -> 1 -> 2 in Update.

fields.name: riseSpeed
fields.evidence: Written from fVar2 and scaled by DAT_0059298C to drive the rise step.

fields.evidence: Installed from DAT_003e5d48 by the constructor.

fields.name: frameTimer
fields.evidence: Loaded with 0x78 (or 0xF0), decremented each update, and clamped/finished at -1.

summary: Scene effect slot: holds a scene/camera reference, a slot index, a sprite handle, and an active flag for a field sprite effect.
evidence: Create 0x003E3ACC reads scene/camera +0x78/+0x7C through +0x28, stores a slot index at +0x2C and a sprite pointer at +0x30, and sets active u16 +0x34; Release 0x003E3F10 frees the sprite; vtable 0x0076AEBC.

fields.name: vtable
fields.evidence: Written from DAT_003e4004 and from the create path (piVar2[0] = iVar3 / DAT_003e3db8-derived value); the first word holds the class vtable.

fields.name: unknown_0x4
fields.evidence: Only appears in bitfield index arithmetic (piVar2[1] >> 0xB masked with DAT_003e3dc0); the decompiled evidence does not show that it belongs to this object, so no purpose is claimed.

fields.name: scene
fields.evidence: Dereferenced as a scene/camera: reads +0x78 and +0x7C into local coordinates.

fields.name: slotIndex
fields.evidence: Set to iVar3 (slot/count) during Create and cleared/initialised in the destructor; likely an array or slot index.

fields.name: sprite
fields.evidence: Sprite/effect handle: tested for null, dereferenced at +0x4, and released through FUN_0028E630.

fields.name: isActive
fields.evidence: Set to 1/0 as a 16-bit flag around create and release.

fields.name: unknown_0x22C
fields.evidence: piVar2[0x8B] = DAT_003e3db8 + 0x98 lies inside a fully inlined create helper that also allocates a new sprite actor; the write may target that new object rather than this one, so both this offset and the 560-byte size remain unverified.
